args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I appreciate how clean and straightforward it is — it's easy to see right away that it's your personal site and how to reach you. That said, I think it could benefit from a bit more content, such as a short bio, your interests, or some of your work/projects. Adding a little more personality would make it more engaging for visitors. Overall, a nice minimal starting point!

Hi Eve! I just visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that you mention hiking as your favorite hobby — it gives the blog a personal touch right away. I'd suggest expanding on that with posts about your favorite trails, hiking tips, or photos from your adventures. That kind of content would make your blog more engaging and give readers a reason to come back. Looking forward to seeing where you take it!
